opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until October 22, 2018, within which *309to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
